environment.substrate: headless Chromium: real layout and hit-testing, a click is a mouse press on a part of the element that shows, typing is key events, and the hand can also hover, drag, nudge, press three times and wait; virtual clock; one small fixed window

parameters.split_rule: sha256(task name) mod 4 == 0 is development, the rest held out

read_this_first: REPLICATION RUN, 2026-11-12, on seeds nobody had used. 50 MiniWoB++ pages, the first 50 by name, 10 instances each from seeds 1080-1089 (run 5 used 1060-1079; seeds 1040-1059 were the pilot). HeadlessChrome/153.0.8010.0 via miniwob_chromium_bridge_v1.mjs, real mouse, page's full reward the only judge, 30-second page limit. NOT the same task set as run 5 (that used all 130), so compare arms WITHIN this run, and compare the ORDERING against V5 rather than the absolute numbers. What it does: it shows the ordering of the ladder reproduces on instances that did not exist when the learner was written -- version_space over verbatim over random, and the same skill denied the instruction falls back. What it does NOT show: 50 pages is not 130, 17 of the 50 had no first success and are counted as such, and no new mechanism was added, so nothing here extends the capability.
